dataset: TSLA versus SPY daily adjusted-close return example

ratings.nature: Manually transcribed public reporting, not complete vendor rating history
ratings.date_policy: Preserve reported announcement dates, including weekends. The event-study backend maps each to the next supplied trading session; unverified publication timestamps do not establish analyst-note release times.
ratings.selection_warning: Small hand-selected illustration with incomplete coverage, overlapping windows and possible contemporaneous news confounding; not a representative causal sample.

alignment.calendar: Exchange-local daily dates, converted from UTC Yahoo timestamps using America/New_York

transformation.formula: ret_t = TSLA_Adj_Close_t / TSLA_Adj_Close_(t-1) - 1; mkt_t = SPY_Adj_Close_t / SPY_Adj_Close_(t-1) - 1
transformation.missing_data_policy: No fill, calendar compression, or unadjusted-close fallback. Duplicate or mismatched calendars and missing adjusted closes fail validation. First-row returns remain NaN because no preceding sample price exists.
transformation.benchmark: SPY adjusted-close return is a tradable broad US equity benchmark proxy, not a fitted market model or a market excess-return factor.

limitations: Yahoo adjusted prices can be revised retrospectively for corporate actions and corrections; this snapshot is not an original vendor point-in-time database.
The raw endpoint may include metadata outside the requested historical period. Returns use only the validated historical timestamp/price arrays.
Identical TSLA/SPY calendars do not independently prove exchange-calendar completeness; both sources could omit the same session.
Rating events are rebuilt from separately cited manual source records. Only prices are downloaded by this script.
reproduce: python prepare_real_example.py (offline); python prepare_real_example.py --download (explicit network refresh)
